name: Dynamite Belial
description: The Demon King at full power. Dynamite Belial has transcended its limits — a godlike Balance type that dominates through overwhelming force, unholy resilience, and a demonic second wind that turns near-death into absolute destruction.

ability.name: Demon King's Wrath
ability.description: Each time Belial wins an Attack phase, it heals 10 HP and stacks +10 Attack permanently (max +50). At 5 stacks, Belial enters DEMON MODE for the rest of the battle: all stats gain +10 and the Special Move charges an extra hit.

special_move.name: Belial Apocalypse
special_move.description: The Demon King unleashes the full wrath of the underworld — a four-hit demolition that shatters the stadium and leaves nothing standing!
flavour_texts: 👑 **Hit 1** — The Demon King rises from the abyss!
💥 **Hit 2** — The stadium walls crack under the shockwave!
💣 **Hit 4** — BELIAL APOCALYPSE — DEMON KING'S JUDGMENT — TOTAL ANNIHILATION!
